title: 第9章 这畜生断不可留第10章 特质 破邪之力
slug: 是攻略系统不是攻城略地系统
content_zh:
而也就是在这个时候，李凯南的系统面板忽然跳出了提示。
【精通攻略的您采取了“英雄救美”的计策，在最其恰当的时机，摧枯拉朽地击败了狼人，大幅度提高了对重要剧情人物“小红帽”布兰妮的攻略进度。
您那英武无敌的形象将深深印刻在她的心目中，成为惊艳布兰妮一生的英雄……】
【击败狼人，获得奖励特质：月之子（您得到了月亮的眷顾，可以汲取月华之力提高自己的力量、恢复自身的体力、治愈受到的伤势……）】
-------------------
【精通*****，在********摧枯拉朽地击败了狼人，大幅度提高了******进度。
您那英武无敌的形象***********，成为****布兰妮**……】
【击败狼人，获得奖励特质：月之子（您得到了月亮的眷顾，可以汲取月华之力提高自己的力量、恢复自身的体力、治愈受到的伤势……）】
看系统提示，布兰妮的剧情任务貌似是走完了。
接下来只要好感度足够，应该就可以直接招入麾下了！
很好，这次保底能招募一个成长型npc伙伴……
除此之外，拿到了一个特质奖励。
月之子？
李凯南微微抬眸，看了一眼头顶的月亮。
天空之上圆月高悬，散落银白色月华辉光。
月光照耀在身上，李凯南只觉得有一缕又一缕、源源不断的力量正在汇入到自己的体内。
一路之上匆促赶回来所消耗的体力，此时也得到了充足的恢复。
同时五感也变得更加敏锐，原本夜色笼罩下的幽深森林，此时在李凯南的眼中居然和白天的森林没有什么区别！
好东西，夜战buff啊。
看来以后打仗，可以多带兵去夜袭敌军！

系统虽然有bug，但在给奖励方面还是从来不含糊的，这让李凯南的心情很是愉快……
……
而李凯南此时因为奖励不错而浮现在脸上的笑容，也落到了偷偷打量着他的狼人眼中。
一时之间，原本还在惊慌惶恐的狼人心中陡然一喜。
人类贵族就是这样的，只要愿意投降他们就会手下留情，以展示他们那虚伪的仁慈和可笑的骑士精神，真是太愚蠢了……
只是狼人的窃喜并没有持续多久，李凯南便再度看向它。
李凯南脸上的笑意此时已经淡去，但眼神之中的冰冷杀意并没有淡去半分。
狡猾的独臂狼人见状，一下子就从窃喜中反应过来。
恐惧如同潮水一般再度袭来，让独臂狼人浑身发软，连忙求饶道：
“我愿意拿出我所有的一切进行赔偿……看在我还没有伤人，勇武尊贵又仁慈的大人啊，求您放过我吧！”
任务要求是“击败”，而且奖励都已经拿到手了，李凯南确实可以不杀掉它。
但这狼人狡诈又多变，留它在身边只怕李凯南以后睡觉都得睁着一只眼睛！
放过它？
怎么可能！
面对求饶的独臂狼人，李凯南表情淡漠。
没伤人就可以不用死了？
李凯南扫了一眼四周，便注意到了刚刚因为忠于职守而被狼人一脚踢死的猎犬。
他眼神一冷，当即呵斥道：
content_en:
It was at this time that a prompt suddenly popped up on Li Kainan's system panel.
[You who are proficient in strategy adopted the strategy of "hero saves beauty" and defeated the werewolf at the most appropriate time, greatly improving the progress of the strategy for "Little Red Riding Hood" Britney, an important plot character.
Your heroic and invincible image will be deeply engraved in her mind and you will become a hero who will amaze Britney throughout her life...]
[Defeat the werewolf and obtain the reward trait: Son of the Moon (you have been favored by the moon and can draw on the power of the moon to improve your strength, restore your physical strength, and heal injuries...)]
-------------------
[Proficient in *****, defeated the werewolf in ******* and greatly improved the progress of *******.
Your heroic and invincible image, *************, becomes ****Britney**...]
[Defeat the werewolf and obtain the reward trait: Son of the Moon (you have been favored by the moon and can draw on the power of the moon to improve your strength, restore your physical strength, and heal injuries...)]
Judging from the system prompts, it seems that Britney's plot mission has been completed.
Next, as long as you have enough favorability, you should be able to recruit him directly!
Very good, this time I am guaranteed to recruit a growth-oriented NPC partner...
In addition, I received a trait reward.
Moonchild?
Li Kainan raised his eyes slightly and glanced at the moon above his head.
The full moon hangs high in the sky, scattering silver-white moonlight.
The moonlight shone on his body, and Li Kainan felt that strand after strand of power was flowing into his body.
The energy consumed in rushing back along the way was fully recovered at this time.
At the same time, the five senses have become more acute. In Li Kainan's eyes, the deep forest that was originally shrouded in darkness is no different from the forest during the day!
Good thing, night battle buff.
It seems that in future wars, we can lead more troops to attack the enemy at night!
Although the system has bugs, it is never ambiguous in giving rewards, which makes Li Kainan feel very happy...
…
The smile that appeared on Li Kainan's face because of the good reward also fell into the eyes of the werewolf who secretly looked at him.
Suddenly, the werewolf who was still panicking suddenly felt happy.
Human nobles are like this. They will show mercy as long as they are willing to surrender to show their false kindness and ridiculous chivalry. It is really stupid...
However, the werewolf's secret joy did not last long, and Li Kainan looked at it again.
The smile on Li Kainan's face had faded at this time, but the cold murderous intent in his eyes had not faded by half.
When the cunning one-armed werewolf saw this, he immediately recovered from his secret joy.
Fear came over again like a tide, making the one-armed werewolf go weak and he quickly begged for mercy:
"I am willing to use everything I have to compensate... Seeing that I have not hurt anyone, my brave, noble and kind lord, please let me go!"
The mission requirement is "defeat", and the rewards have been obtained, so Li Kainan really doesn't need to kill it.
But this werewolf is cunning and changeable. If he keeps it by his side, Li Kainan will have to sleep with one eye open in the future!
Let it go?
How is that possible!
Facing the one-armed werewolf begging for mercy, Li Kainan looked indifferent.
If no one is hurt, then there is no need to die?
Li Kainan glanced around and noticed the hound that had just been kicked to death by a werewolf for being loyal to his duty.
His eyes turned cold and he immediately scolded:
